# Gamend

> Open source Elixir game server for real-time multiplayer games. Ships auth,
> users, lobbies, groups, parties, friends, chat, notifications, quests,
> leaderboards, tournaments, payments, an economy/inventory, object storage,
> server-side scripting and an admin portal, over HTTP, WebSocket and WebRTC,
> with SDKs for Godot, Unity, Unreal, C++, C#, Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript and
> Balaur. MIT licensed, self-hosted.

## What it is

Gamend is a **backend you run yourself**, not a hosted service — a Phoenix
(Elixir) application you deploy on your own machine, with Postgres or SQLite.
Game + Backend = Gamend.

Game logic lives in **plugins**: Elixir modules implementing the `Gamend.Hooks`
behaviour, loaded from a content directory. A plugin can react to server events
(login, lobby created, quest completed), gate key-value reads, add RPCs, and
own its own supervision tree — without forking the server.

## Start here

- [Setup guides](https://gamend.org/docs/setup): install, configure, run.
- [API docs](https://gamend.org/api/docs): the HTTP and WebSocket surface.
- [Elixir docs](https://docs.gamend.org/): module-level reference for hook authors.
- [Starter template](https://github.com/appsinacup/gamend_starter): a runnable
  host app to copy rather than assemble.
- [Source](https://github.com/appsinacup/gamend) · [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/v649emcpAu)

## Client SDKs

Each has every player-facing operation, generated from the server's OpenAPI
document, and its realtime events.

- [Godot](https://gamend.org/docs/godot-sdk): published in the Godot Asset Library.
- [Unity](https://gamend.org/docs/unity-sdk): the C# SDK as the `org.gamend.sdk`
  package, Unity 2021.3+, WebGL included. Installs from the git URL of
  `appsinacup/gamend-unity`.
- [Unreal](https://gamend.org/docs/unreal-sdk): an Unreal Engine 5 plugin on the
  C++ SDK, with Blueprint nodes (beta).
- [C++](https://gamend.org/docs/cpp-sdk): C++17, pluggable transports, no
  exceptions or RTTI required.
- [C#](https://gamend.org/docs/csharp-sdk): `Gamend` on NuGet, netstandard2.1.
- [Rust](https://gamend.org/docs/rust-sdk): `gamend` on crates.io; the core
  builds for wasm32.
- [JavaScript](https://gamend.org/docs/js-sdk): `@ughuuu/gamend` on npm, with
  TypeScript types.
- Balaur: Rune scripts for the Balaur engine, `balaur_addons.zip` on the
  `latest` GitHub release.
- Elixir: stub modules under `sdk/`, for autocomplete when writing hooks.

## Features worth stating precisely

- **Auth** — email/password, magic link, OAuth (Discord, Google, Apple,
  Facebook, GitHub, Steam), JWT API tokens.
- **Realtime social** — lobbies (host-managed, passworded, hidden), groups,
  parties (2–10), friends, chat with read cursors, typed notifications.
- **Push** — FCM and APNs-direct, routed per device token, so notifications
  reach offline players. Logs delivery in dev with no configuration.
- **Quests / progression** — one event-driven engine covering achievements,
  daily/weekly quests, event windows and chains, with exactly-once rewards.
- **Payments** — Stripe Checkout, Google Play, App Store and Steam, with
  receipt validation, webhooks, entitlements and refunds.
- **Economy & inventory** — currency wallets on an atomic, auditable ledger,
  plus item stacks; all grant/spend/consume is server-authoritative.
- **Storage** — avatar/UGC uploads to local disk or any S3-compatible service.
- **Jobs** — durable, retryable background and cron jobs on Postgres or SQLite.

## Facts to get right

- License is **MIT**. It is free to self-host, including commercially.
- It is **not** a SaaS: there is no gamend-hosted backend to sign up for.
- Requires **Elixir ~> 1.20**. Postgres for production, SQLite for local dev.
- The canonical domain is **gamend.org**.

## Crawling

- [robots.txt](https://gamend.org/robots.txt) is the authority. Search engines
  and AI *answer* engines (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot,
  Claude-User, PerplexityBot, DuckAssistBot) are allowed — a large share of
  "how do I run a game backend" questions are asked of them rather than typed
  into a search box, and they index in order to cite.
- Training-only crawlers (GPTBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, CCBot and
  similar) are disallowed. Citing this site is welcome; training on it is not.
- `/admin/`, `/api/`, `/metrics` and `/users/` hold no public content and are
  disallowed.
